{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes CMake build system, CI configuration (.github/ci-windows.py, .github/workflows/ci.yml), and compiler requirements for native Windows builds, bearing 'Build system' and 'Windows' labels.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Switching native Windows builds to clang-cl cuts Windows CI build time by ~38%, improves benchmarked validation performance by ~55%, and eliminates persistent MSVC compiler bug workarounds. The author notes that 'ConnectBlockAllEcdsa improving from 7.40 to 11.52 block/s (~55%)' and CI time drops from 20m 35s to 12m 43s while retiring multiple MSVC workarounds (#31456, #36153)."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Documentation updates (doc/build-windows-native.md, release notes) merely document the build system transition.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation edits directly follow from the build toolchain change."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/CMakeLists.txt only to adjust compiler flag handling.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not affect the libbitcoinkernel API, boundary, or validation encapsulation."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch P2P networking code or protocols.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "No P2P logic or files are modified."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Removes an MSVC-specific workaround in src/test/util_not_null_tests.cpp as a consequence of dropping MSVC support.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change test frameworks or test harness infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to endian/byteswap compatibility headers and vendored package cmake files are mechanical follow-ups to removing MSVC compiler support.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Compatibility header cleanups follow directly from the build toolchain switch."
    }
  ],
